note: Named retrieval configs. env is applied to process.env BEFORE retrieve.js is loaded (it reads RAG_TOP_K and RAG_MAX_CHARS at module load). retriever: hybrid drives search()/searchMulti(); dense and bm25 drive the per-retriever lists from retrieve.__debug.isolated() through the production finish() so the char budget applies identically. RAG_DB is always the snapshot unless overridden on the command line.
